reuse.why: All six month-wide actions share category selection, while tag parsing, spreadsheet reads, budget writes and undo registration reuse existing helpers.

duplication.why: The repeated category queries are consolidated, although the new action repeats the income eligibility guard already present in existing actions.

placement.why: Selection and spending logic remain in budget/actions.ts, with typed method registration and undo composition in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, relevant tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: The shared selector and argument type make future exclusion changes straightforward, though income eligibility remains distributed across callers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every affected month-wide action calls getMonthWideActionCategories, and the new method uses the existing mutator and undoable wrappers.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated selection queries are replaced with shared calls; the remaining income guard repetition is explicit.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideActionCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter and conditional hidden-filter override; all six consumers continue through the selector.
